B.text:
def test_subset_hook_caller(pm: PluginManager) -> None:
    class Hooks:
        @hookspec
        def he_method1(self, arg):
            pass

    pm.add_hookspecs(Hooks)

    out = []

    class Plugin1:
        @hookimpl
        def he_method1(self, arg):
            out.append(arg)

    class Plugin2:
        @hookimpl
        def he_method1(self, arg):
            out.append(arg * 10)

    class PluginNo:
        pass

    plugin1, plugin2, plugin3 = Plugin1(), Plugin2(), PluginNo()
    pm.register(plugin1)
    pm.register(plugin2)
    pm.register(plugin3)
    pm.hook.he_method1(arg=1)
    assert out == [10, 1]
    out[:] = []

    hc = pm.subset_hook_caller("he_method1", [plugin1])
    hc(arg=2)
    assert out == [20]
    out[:] = []

    hc = pm.subset_hook_caller("he_method1", [plugin2])
    hc(arg=2)
    assert out == [2]
    out[:] = []

    pm.unregister(plugin1)
    hc(arg=2)
    assert out == []
    out[:] = []

    pm.hook.he_method1(arg=1)
    assert out == [10]

    assert repr(hc) == "<_SubsetHookCaller 'he_method1'>"
